series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and weak seasonality with high noise levels. Concept drift and unstable model rankings suggest a weighted combination approach with dynamic error adaptation is appropriate to account for changing model performance.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift suggests dynamic error weighting (ADE) is appropriate to adapt to changing model performance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.top_k=4 AND series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high → high regularization with shrinkage=0.35 and top_k=4 aligns with recommended knobs
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2 → ridge stacking overfits with few windows
